page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines with an ornament woodcut between the lines and the imprint; no margins with text. The blue area at the left is the scan edge, not printed.
page.notes: Ornament woodcut (fleuron) between the author lines and the imprint, not transcribed. Scan edge at left is blue and cut; the first letter of STAVROLATRIA is cut off by the edge and is printed as S. Some letters in the italic lines are worn; "Staurolatras" and "Disputatio" read as printed.
